report_sentences: Reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch showed no effect beyond noise.
Finally, I ran direct tests with mass 0.1 kg, radius 0.2 m spheres at extreme reflectance (0 vs 1) and temperature (−20 vs 80 °C).
- The residual correlations with reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch were all ≤0.16 in magnitude.
The reflectance and temperature extremes gave identical results within noise.
Reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch are irrelevant.
